f.title: State pharmacovigilance system covers ADRs and other harmful drug-related reactions
f.statement: The State establishes a pharmacovigilance system to monitor, identify, assess and control adverse drug reactions and other harmful reactions related to drug use.
f.applicability: China; Drug Administration Law of the PRC (2019 revision, in force from 1 December 2019), official Chinese text. Supplements the English partial curation cat-cn-dal-2019-revision (Arts 1-50); duties already curated there (Arts 6, 22, 30, 37, 38, 39, 40, 49) are not repeated.

rows.actor: The State (framework for MAH pharmacovigilance duties)
rows.quote: 国家建立药物警戒制度，对药品不良反应及其他与用药有关的有害反应进行监测、识别、评估和控制。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim; re-translation agrees. Double-check: the duty is the State's; kept because it sets the legal scope (ADRs and other harmful drug-related reactions; monitor, identify, assess, control) that MAH PV systems implement (GVP, Implementing Regulations Art 24). Level Mandatory as a binding legal provision; actor is not a company, hence below 90.
rows.quote_en: The State establishes a pharmacovigilance system to monitor, identify, assess and control adverse drug reactions and other harmful reactions related to drug use.

f.title: Draw up a post-marketing risk management plan and conduct post-marketing studies
f.statement: MAHs shall draw up a post-marketing risk management plan, proactively conduct post-marketing studies to further confirm the drug's safety, efficacy and quality controllability, and strengthen continuous management of marketed drugs.
f.applicability: China; Drug Administration Law of the PRC (2019 revision, in force from 1 December 2019), official Chinese text. Supplements the English partial curation cat-cn-dal-2019-revision (Arts 1-50); duties already curated there (Arts 6, 22, 30, 37, 38, 39, 40, 49) are not repeated.
f.exceptions: Failure to draw up the plan or conduct post-marketing studies is penalised under Art 127(6) and (7).
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Epidemiology / safety studies

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (药品上市许可持有人)
rows.quote: 药品上市许可持有人应当制定药品上市后风险管理计划，主动开展药品上市后研究，对药品的安全性、有效性和质量可控性进行进一步确证，加强对已上市药品的持续管理。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim from the Chinese text; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Not in the English partial file (Arts 1-50 only). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当.
rows.quote_en: The drug marketing authorisation holder shall formulate a post-marketing risk management plan, proactively carry out post-marketing studies, further confirm the safety, efficacy and quality controllability of the drug, and strengthen the continuous management of marketed drugs.

f.title: Take risk management measures and complete required studies for conditionally approved drugs
f.statement: For conditionally approved drugs, the MAH shall take corresponding risk management measures and complete the required studies within the prescribed time limit; if the studies are not completed as required on time, or benefit cannot be shown to outweigh risk, NMPA shall act according to law, up to cancelling the drug registration certificate.
f.applicability: China; Drug Administration Law of the PRC (2019 revision, in force from 1 December 2019), official Chinese text. Supplements the English partial curation cat-cn-dal-2019-revision (Arts 1-50); duties already curated there (Arts 6, 22, 30, 37, 38, 39, 40, 49) are not repeated. Conditionally approved drugs (附条件批准, Art 26).
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Epidemiology / safety studies; Benefit–risk review

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (药品上市许可持有人)
rows.deadline: Within the time limit set in the conditional approval
rows.quote: 对附条件批准的药品，药品上市许可持有人应当采取相应风险管理措施，并在规定期限内按照要求完成相关研究；逾期未按照要求完成研究或者不能证明其获益大于风险的，国务院药品监督管理部门应当依法处理，直至注销药品注册证书。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim from the Chinese text; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Not in the English partial file (Arts 1-50 only). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当. Time limit is set case by case, so no deadline_rule.
rows.quote_en: For drugs approved with conditions, the drug marketing authorisation holder shall take corresponding risk management measures and complete the relevant studies as required within the prescribed time limit; where the studies are not completed as required after the time limit, or it cannot be proven that the benefits outweigh the risks, the drug regulatory department under the State Council shall deal with it according to law, up to cancellation of the drug registration certificate.

f.title: Monitor post-marketing ADRs, collect and analyse suspected ADRs, and control identified risks
f.statement: MAHs shall conduct post-marketing adverse drug reaction monitoring, proactively collect, track and analyse information on suspected adverse drug reactions, and promptly take risk control measures for drugs with identified risks.
f.applicability: China; Drug Administration Law of the PRC (2019 revision, in force from 1 December 2019), official Chinese text. Supplements the English partial curation cat-cn-dal-2019-revision (Arts 1-50); duties already curated there (Arts 6, 22, 30, 37, 38, 39, 40, 49) are not repeated.
f.exceptions: Failure to conduct ADR monitoring is penalised under Art 134 (warning, then suspension and fines of 100,000-1,000,000 yuan).
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Signal detection; Risk management & minimisation

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (药品上市许可持有人)
rows.quote: 药品上市许可持有人应当开展药品上市后不良反应监测，主动收集、跟踪分析疑似药品不良反应信息，对已识别风险的药品及时采取风险控制措施。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim from the Chinese text; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Not in the English partial file (Arts 1-50 only). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当.
rows.quote_en: The drug marketing authorisation holder shall carry out post-marketing adverse drug reaction monitoring, proactively collect, track and analyse information on suspected adverse drug reactions, and promptly take risk control measures for drugs with identified risks.

f.title: Regularly examine the quality, efficacy and adverse reactions of own drugs
f.statement: MAHs, drug manufacturers, drug distributors and medical institutions shall regularly examine the quality, efficacy and adverse reactions of the drugs they manufacture, distribute or use.
f.applicability: China; Drug Administration Law of the PRC (2019 revision, in force from 1 December 2019), official Chinese text. Supplements the English partial curation cat-cn-dal-2019-revision (Arts 1-50); duties already curated there (Arts 6, 22, 30, 37, 38, 39, 40, 49) are not repeated.

rows.actor: MAH, drug manufacturer, drug distributor (and medical institution)
rows.quote: 药品上市许可持有人、药品生产企业、药品经营企业和医疗机构应当经常考察本单位所生产、经营、使用的药品质量、疗效和不良反应。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim from the Chinese text; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Not in the English partial file (Arts 1-50 only). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当.
rows.quote_en: Drug marketing authorisation holders, drug manufacturers, drug distributors and medical institutions shall regularly examine the quality, efficacy and adverse reactions of drugs produced, distributed or used by their units.

f.title: Report suspected ADRs promptly to the drug regulatory and health authorities
f.statement: On discovering a suspected adverse reaction, MAHs, drug manufacturers, drug distributors and medical institutions shall report it promptly to the drug regulatory department and the health administrative department. Detailed rules are set by NMPA together with the National Health Commission.
f.applicability: China; Drug Administration Law of the PRC (2019 revision, in force from 1 December 2019), official Chinese text. Supplements the English partial curation cat-cn-dal-2019-revision (Arts 1-50); duties already curated there (Arts 6, 22, 30, 37, 38, 39, 40, 49) are not repeated.
f.exceptions: Failure to report suspected ADRs is penalised under Art 134.

rows.actor: MAH, drug manufacturer, drug distributor (and medical institution)
rows.quote: 发现疑似不良反应的，应当及时向药品监督管理部门和卫生健康主管部门报告。具体办法由国务院药品监督管理部门会同国务院卫生健康主管部门制定。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim from the Chinese text; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Not in the English partial file (Arts 1-50 only). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当. Actor from the preceding sentence of Art 81(1). 及时 has no number, so no deadline_rule.
rows.quote_en: Where a suspected adverse reaction is discovered, it shall be reported promptly to the drug regulatory department and the health administrative department. The specific measures shall be formulated by the drug regulatory department under the State Council together with the health administrative department under the State Council.

f.title: Stop sale, recall and report when a drug has a quality problem or other safety hazard
f.statement: Where a drug has a quality problem or other potential safety hazard, the MAH shall immediately stop sale, inform the distributors and medical institutions concerned to stop sale and use, recall the drugs sold, promptly publish the recall information, immediately stop production where necessary, and report the recall and handling to the provincial drug regulatory department and health administrative department. Drug manufacturers, distributors and medical institutions shall cooperate.
f.applicability: China; Drug Administration Law of the PRC (2019 revision, in force from 1 December 2019), official Chinese text. Supplements the English partial curation cat-cn-dal-2019-revision (Arts 1-50); duties already curated there (Arts 6, 22, 30, 37, 38, 39, 40, 49) are not repeated.
f.exceptions: If the MAH fails to recall, the provincial authority orders the recall (Art 82(2)); refusal is penalised under Art 135.
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Quality system & CAPA; Safety communications

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (药品上市许可持有人)
rows.quote: 药品存在质量问题或者其他安全隐患的，药品上市许可持有人应当立即停止销售，告知相关药品经营企业和医疗机构停止销售和使用，召回已销售的药品，及时公开召回信息，必要时应当立即停止生产，并将药品召回和处理情况向省、自治区、直辖市人民政府药品监督管理部门和卫生健康主管部门报告。药品生产企业、药品经营企业和医疗机构应当配合。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim from the Chinese text; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Not in the English partial file (Arts 1-50 only). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当.
rows.quote_en: Where a drug has quality problems or other potential safety hazards, the drug marketing authorisation holder shall immediately stop sales, notify the relevant drug distributors and medical institutions to stop sale and use, recall the drugs sold, promptly disclose the recall information, where necessary immediately stop production, and report the recall and handling to the drug regulatory department and the health administrative department of the people's government of the province, autonomous region or municipality. Drug manufacturers, drug distributors and medical institutions shall cooperate.

f.title: Conduct periodic post-marketing evaluation of marketed drugs
f.statement: MAHs shall periodically carry out post-marketing evaluation of the safety, efficacy and quality controllability of marketed drugs. Where necessary, NMPA may order the MAH to carry out a post-marketing evaluation or organise one directly.
f.applicability: China; Drug Administration Law of the PRC (2019 revision, in force from 1 December 2019), official Chinese text. Supplements the English partial curation cat-cn-dal-2019-revision (Arts 1-50); duties already curated there (Arts 6, 22, 30, 37, 38, 39, 40, 49) are not repeated.
f.exceptions: Drugs with uncertain efficacy, major adverse reactions or other harm shall have their registration certificate cancelled after evaluation (Art 83(2)); failure to conduct evaluation is penalised under Art 127(7).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (药品上市许可持有人)
rows.quote: 药品上市许可持有人应当对已上市药品的安全性、有效性和质量可控性定期开展上市后评价。必要时，国务院药品监督管理部门可以责令药品上市许可持有人开展上市后评价或者直接组织开展上市后评价。
rows.review_note: Review: quote verbatim from the Chinese text; independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force (应当 = shall). Not in the English partial file (Arts 1-50 only). Double-check: statement stays within the quote; Mandatory follows 应当. No interval stated for "periodically".
rows.quote_en: The drug marketing authorisation holder shall periodically carry out post-marketing evaluation of the safety, efficacy and quality controllability of marketed drugs. Where necessary, the drug regulatory department under the State Council may order the drug marketing authorisation holder to carry out post-marketing evaluation or directly organise post-marketing evaluation.

dates.title: PRC Drug Administration Law (2019 revision): takes effect
dates.scope: All parties engaged in drug development, manufacture, distribution, use and supervision in China, including MAHs
dates.quote_en: This Law shall take effect from 1 December 2019.
dates.timing_note: 施行 = takes effect, so kind effective. No transition period stated.
